archer.notes: Crimson Archer. Base = archer_v1 (crimson flat). run_smooth/roll/knockdown/dissolve come from archer_v2, tinted toward v1 crimson; v2 keeps its black ink lines, so those frames read slightly more detailed.

hit_flash.note: single hit frame + runtime white flash

acoustic_hunter.notes: Acoustic Hunter (blind). Dedicated sheet. The large reference figure (bottom-left) is not sliced.

executioner.notes: Void Executioner (v1). One frame per pose: idle breathing, walk bob and wind-up shake are procedural. Slam FX borrowed from executioners_v2.

sweep.note: no sweep art: wind-up pose rotated + slam pose; uses 'drag' as follow-through

phantom.notes: Phantom (v1, crimson). v2 phantom is grey = violates red-is-hostile, not used. No jump art: jump reuses the dash pose.

jump.note: no jump art: dash pose reused for airborne

iron_monk.notes: Iron Monk (v1). Flail spin is one pose; spinning is procedural (rotating flail sprite).

blood_archer.notes: Blood Archer (v1). Rain-of-arrows uses the arrow sprite at runtime (no rain art).

warden.notes: Warden (v1). Shield is baked into body frames (front-facing guard).

boss_leviathan.notes: Crimson Leviathan. Body frames = boss_leviathan_v2; phase_transition (white-hot, also the 'real one' in the clone fight), shockwave, sword trails, floating swords and clone silhouettes = v1. Energy pillars + floor fractures from v2 because v1 draws them fused into one image.

clone.note: clones = body frames tinted dark (fake wind-ups need the full move set)

wall_skewer.note: 0 mount, 1 idle, 2 warning, 3 fired, 4 retracted spear

hazards_secondary.notes: Second hazard sheet. Its 'laser emitters' are dart launchers with a dotted red sight line; real beam lasers come from hazards_grid_obstacles.

false_floor.note: 0 hidden, 1 shaking, 2 spikes burst, 3 spikes settled

hazards_grid_obstacles.notes: Grid obstacle sheet (grid lines keyed out).

laser_beam.note: 0 charging (thin), 1 full beam; stretch at runtime

laser_emitter_off.note: sheet's 'off' emitter is too faint to key; idle frame dimmed at runtime
